title: Trace Fabric runs and dataset lineage
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. A run ID connects execution evidence to published data. Activity dependency IDs must resolve inside the same run. A successful activity with an orphaned Target run ID is not traceable. This lesson scores activities without a known run/state/source/target, unresolved or unsuccessful dependencies, and Target rows whose run ID is absent. Each activity or Target row counts once in each applicable rule; UNKNOWN is an evidence gap, not a fabricated success.
learning_objectives: Trace Fabric runs and dataset lineage
Separate execution, quality and incomplete evidence.
